# This is Lisboa East Centre
# October 2025
# By Miguel Sousa AKA @Leep_here on Discord

#### DESCRIPTION ####
# This is Lisbon East Centre/Center

# It contains:

# Lisbon, Porto and Faro airports
# Enroute aircraft!:)
# SID's and STAR's for all the active runways
# Custom configs for realism

# Others
# If your interested in their individual approach control check it out in #europe at EATC discord channel,..
# LPPR and LPFR made by me; LPPT made by Kimvan on Discord, check them out!
# Kimvan has authorized my person to sample his LPPT and coastline, for use in this file and other files, if u want to sample them talk to him!
# Beware Enroute aircraft is still being worked on since it's a new thing for me!

# Configs

# Config1 to config7
# All airports are open
# Enroute traffic
# Depending on the config number the runways in use are different

# Config8 to config9
# LPPT open
# Enroute traffic

# Config10 to config17
# Lisbon and depending on the config number LPPR or LPFR are open
# Enroute traffic

# Config18 to config25
# LPFR and/or LPPR open
# Enroute traffic closed
